sections.title: Welcome
sections.quote: Say farewell to a legend: Wynton Marsalis takes the stage for the last time as music director of the Jazz at Lincoln Center Orchestra, stepping down at the end of the 2026/27 season. From first note to last, his victory lap will be one to remember.
body: Say farewell to a legend when Wynton Marsalis takes the stage for the last time as music director and member of the Jazz at Lincoln Center Orchestra. A champion of jazz and a fierce advocate for its place in American culture and history, Marsalis steps down as music director at the end of the 2026/27 season. From first note to last, Wynton Marsalis' victory lap with his Orchestra will be one to remember.

body: Vivo Performing Arts gathers and performs on the unceded ancestral lands of the Massachusett, Pawtucket, and Wampanoag peoples.
Assistive listening devices are available. For ASL or audio description on selected performances, contact access@vivoperformingarts.org at least one week in advance.
